sentences.text: (Dated this the 30th day of March, 2026) The sole accused in Crime No. 2299 of 2021 of Petta Police Station filed this Crl.MC under Section 482 Cr.PC praying for quashing all further proceedings against him.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the accused after promising to marry the defacto complainant, took her to various hotels, committed rape upon her, took her nude photographs and video, intimidated her and thereafter refused to marry her and thereby he is alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.
3. According to the learned Counsel for the petitioner, now the entire dispute between the petitioner and the defacto complainant has been settled.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.

4. The learned Counsel for the 2nd respondent/ defacto complainant also submitted that the matter has been settled between the parties and also that further proceedings 2026:KER:28380 against the petitioner can be quashed.
The defacto complainant also filed an affidavit stating that the matter has been settled and she does not want to proceed with this case.
5. The petition was strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
However upon instruction he submitted that, the defacto complainant has send an e.mail to SHO acknowledging that the matter has been settled.

6. On a perusal of the FI Statement, it can be seen that while the petitioner and the defacto complainant were working together, they became intimate friends and as invited by the petitioner she accompanied him to various places and they had sexual relationship with each other.

Therefore,
prima facie it is appears that the relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant was a consensual one.
Moreover, at the time of their relationship, the de facto complainant was already married to another person.
In the above circumstance, no useful purpose will served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner as the same will only be an abuse of the process of court.
Moreover, now the matter has been settled between the parties.
Therefore, this Crl.MC is allowed.
All further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No. 2299 of 2021 of Petta Police Station, is quashed.
